sentence: This project uses computational approaches to analyze large digital pathology datasets from breast cancer patients and find biomarkers.
This project tries to find out how Streptococcus pyogenes disrupts immune signaling when it interacts with host cells.
This project studies how mutagenic DNA repair pathways help cancer cells survive drugs.
This project studies where master regulators come from in synovial cells and how aging changes them in human joint tissue.
This project combines experiments and computational models to study how the cell cycle adjusts to different biological environments.
This project tests how glucagon hormone treatment affects different zones of the liver in models of health and disease.
This project tests how a panel of genetic changes affects a specific inherited platelet disease.
This project studies how a centrosome transcript for pericentrin-like protein is regulated after transcription.
This project tests whether a compound and DNA vaccines that target a driver mutation can prevent precancer from progressing.
This project studies patients with epilepsy and a rat model with seizures to find ways to prevent and treat seizures and dementia.
This project collects and stores tissue and blood samples from patients and examines tumor samples for sarcoma research.
This project studies how a change in the vasodilation mechanism causes coronary microvascular dysfunction.
This project uses artificial intelligence on electrocardiograms and gene editing of stem cell cardiomyocytes to predict and prevent arrhythmias.
This project studies how losing a leukemia-driver gene affects the competitive fitness of mutant cells, using cell lines and mice.
This project studies how ribs affect the aiming of histotripsy and builds a targeting technique to treat liver tumors.
This project develops methods that use health records to find patients with undiagnosed post-traumatic stress disorder, predict disease trajectories and compare treatments.
This project studies how environmental adversity affects molecular aging in the immune system of companion dogs.
This project studies how the capsid protein of flaviviruses interacts with RNAs in host cells.
This project builds image processing tools that help researchers compare and interpret very large imaging data across subjects, time points, and conditions.
This project tests whether Withania somnifera can treat pelvic pain and infertility in women with endometriosis.
